fieldValues.title: Group / organisation in Programme coordination
fieldValues.summary: A working group or programme that delegates work and must keep its decisions, mandates and compass its own.
goals: Keep authority where it was delegated
Know the context each ruling was made for
jobs: Charter a working group with a mandate
Limit what a member or agent may change
fieldValues.needs: Decisions recorded as records with their scope, enforced mandates, and no authority carried in by a pull request.
